1926.t: Robert Goddard launched the first liquid-fuel rocket
A. A. Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh was published
U.S. Route 66, the highway from Chicago to Los Angeles, was established

1927.t: Charles Lindbergh flew nonstop and alone from New York to Paris
The Jazz Singer, the first feature film with synchronized dialogue, premiered
The Mississippi River burst its levees in the most destructive US river flood on record

1928.t: Mickey Mouse debuted in the sound cartoon Steamboat Willie
The Amsterdam Olympics included women's track and field for the first time

1929.t: US stock prices collapsed in October, setting off the Great Depression
The first Academy Awards were presented in Los Angeles
The Museum of Modern Art opened in New York

1930.t: Uruguay hosted and won the first FIFA World Cup
Gandhi led the Salt March against the British salt monopoly in India

1931.t: The Empire State Building opened as the world's tallest building
Spain's Second Republic was proclaimed and King Alfonso XIII left the country
Central China's rivers flooded in one of the deadliest disasters ever recorded

1932.t: Los Angeles hosted the Summer Olympics, introducing the first athletes' village

1933.t: Germany's Enabling Act handed Hitler's government the power to rule by decree
The Twenty-first Amendment ended Prohibition in the United States
King Kong premiered in New York

1934.t: Mao Zedong's Red Army set out on the Long March
The Dionne sisters became the first quintuplets known to survive infancy
The 'surgeon's photograph' made the Loch Ness Monster world-famous

1935.t: The Social Security Act became US law
Parker Brothers began selling the board game Monopoly
Germany's Nuremberg Laws stripped Jews of citizenship

1936.t: Jesse Owens won four gold medals at the Berlin Olympics
Edward VIII abdicated the British throne to marry Wallis Simpson
The Spanish Civil War began with a military rising against the Republic

1937.t: The Golden Gate Bridge opened in San Francisco
Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, Disney's first animated feature, premiered
The airship Hindenburg burned while landing at Lakehurst, New Jersey

1938.t: Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann split the uranium atom
Superman first appeared in Action Comics No. 1
Nazi mobs burned synagogues and Jewish shops across Germany on Kristallnacht

1939.t: Germany invaded Poland, starting the Second World War in Europe
The New York World's Fair opened, promising 'the world of tomorrow'
Gone with the Wind premiered in Atlanta

1940.t: The Royal Air Force held off the Luftwaffe in the Battle of Britain
Four teenagers found the prehistoric cave paintings of Lascaux
Disney's Fantasia premiered, setting animation to classical music

1941.t: Japan attacked Pearl Harbor and the United States entered World War II
Joe DiMaggio hit in 56 straight games, a record that still stands

1942.t: The US Navy sank four Japanese carriers at the Battle of Midway
Enrico Fermi's team achieved the first controlled nuclear chain reaction

1943.t: The German army surrendered at Stalingrad, a turning point of the war
Jacques Cousteau and Emile Gagnan tested the Aqua-Lung, the first modern scuba gear
Albert Hofmann discovered the psychedelic effects of LSD

1944.t: Allied troops landed on the Normandy beaches on D-Day
The Bretton Woods conference designed the postwar monetary system
The Education Act made secondary schooling free in England and Wales

1945.t: The United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki
Fifty nations signed the United Nations Charter in San Francisco
UNESCO was founded to promote education, science and culture

1946.t: ENIAC, the first general-purpose electronic computer, was unveiled
The Nuremberg tribunal delivered its verdicts on Nazi war crimes
The modern bikini debuted at a Paris poolside fashion show

1947.t: British India was partitioned into independent India and Pakistan
Chuck Yeager flew the Bell X-1 faster than sound, the first supersonic flight
Bell Labs researchers demonstrated the first transistor

1948.t: Israel declared independence as British rule in Palestine ended
The UN adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
London hosted the first Summer Olympics in twelve years

1949.t: Twelve nations signed the North Atlantic Treaty, creating NATO
Mao Zedong proclaimed the People's Republic of China
George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four was published

1950.t: North Korean forces crossed the 38th parallel, starting the Korean War
Uruguay beat hosts Brazil in the deciding match of the World Cup
Charles Schulz's comic strip Peanuts first appeared

1951.t: UNIVAC I, the first commercial computer built in the US, was delivered
I Love Lucy premiered on CBS
Six European nations formed the Coal and Steel Community, forerunner of the EU

1952.t: Elizabeth II became queen on the death of her father, George VI
The United States tested the first hydrogen bomb at Enewetak Atoll
Helsinki hosted the Summer Olympics, where Emil Zatopek won three golds

1953.t: Watson and Crick proposed the double-helix structure of DNA
Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reached the summit of Everest
An armistice halted the fighting in the Korean War

1954.t: Roger Bannister ran the first sub-four-minute mile
The US Supreme Court outlawed racial segregation in public schools
The original Godzilla premiered in Japan

1955.t: The Salk polio vaccine was declared safe and effective
Rosa Parks was arrested and the Montgomery bus boycott began

1956.t: The first Eurovision Song Contest was held in Lugano, Switzerland
The first transatlantic telephone cable entered service
A popular uprising in Hungary was suppressed by Soviet forces

1957.t: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite
The Treaty of Rome created the European Economic Community
Aboard Sputnik 2, the dog Laika became the first living creature in orbit

1958.t: Seventeen-year-old Pele led Brazil to its first World Cup title
Jack Kilby demonstrated the first integrated circuit

1959.t: Fidel Castro's rebels took Havana and toppled the Batista government
Luna 3 sent back the first photographs of the Moon's far side
The Barbie doll debuted at the New York toy fair

1960.t: Abebe Bikila ran the Olympic marathon barefoot to win Ethiopia's first gold
Theodore Maiman operated the first working laser
The strongest earthquake ever recorded struck southern Chile

1961.t: Yuri Gagarin orbited Earth aboard Vostok 1, the first human in space
East Germany sealed the border and began building the Berlin Wall
Amnesty International was founded in London

1962.t: The Cuban Missile Crisis brought the US and USSR to the brink of nuclear war
Telstar relayed the first live television pictures across the Atlantic
Pope John XXIII opened the Second Vatican Council

1963.t: President John F. Kennedy was assassinated in Dallas
Martin Luther King Jr. delivered his 'I Have a Dream' speech in Washington
Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman in space

1964.t: The Civil Rights Act outlawed segregation and discrimination in the US
Tokyo hosted the first Olympic Games held in Asia
Beatlemania swept America after the Beatles' Ed Sullivan debut

1965.t: Alexei Leonov made the first spacewalk from Voskhod 2
The Voting Rights Act banned racial barriers to voting in the US
Intelsat I, the first commercial communications satellite, launched

1966.t: England won the World Cup at Wembley
Luna 9 made the first soft landing on the Moon and sent photos
Mao launched the Cultural Revolution in China

1967.t: Christiaan Barnard performed the first human heart transplant
The Beatles released Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
Israel and its Arab neighbours fought the Six-Day War

1968.t: Apollo 8 carried the first crew around the Moon
Martin Luther King Jr. was assassinated in Memphis
Tommie Smith and John Carlos raised their fists on the Olympic podium

1969.t: Apollo 11 landed and Neil Armstrong walked on the Moon
Nearly half a million people gathered at the Woodstock festival
The first ARPANET link, ancestor of the internet, went live

1970.t: Apollo 13's crew returned safely after an oxygen tank exploded
A cyclone struck East Pakistan, the deadliest storm ever recorded

1971.t: The first microprocessor, the Intel 4004, went on sale
Apollo 15's crew drove the first rover on the Moon
Bangladesh won independence from Pakistan after a liberation war

1972.t: Apollo 17's crew were the last people to walk on the Moon
Atari released Pong, the first hit video game
Eleven Israeli team members were killed at the Munich Olympics

1973.t: Arab oil producers cut exports and world oil prices roughly quadrupled
The United States launched Skylab, its first space station

1974.t: Richard Nixon resigned the presidency over Watergate
The 3.2-million-year-old 'Lucy' skeleton was unearthed in Ethiopia

1975.t: Saigon fell and the Vietnam War ended
Bill Gates and Paul Allen founded Microsoft
US and Soviet spacecraft docked in orbit in the Apollo-Soyuz mission

1976.t: Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak founded Apple
Viking 1 made the first successful landing on Mars
Nadia Comaneci scored the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics

1977.t: Voyagers 1 and 2 set off on their tour of the outer planets
The world's last natural case of smallpox was recorded

1978.t: Louise Brown, the first baby conceived by IVF, was born
Egypt and Israel reached the Camp David Accords
Karol Wojtyla became Pope John Paul II, the first Polish pope

1979.t: The Iranian Revolution overthrew the Shah and created an Islamic republic
Margaret Thatcher became Britain's first female prime minister
Sony introduced the Walkman portable cassette player

1980.t: The WHO declared smallpox eradicated, a first for any human disease
The Solidarity trade union was founded at the Gdansk shipyard

1981.t: The Space Shuttle Columbia flew the first shuttle mission
IBM released its first personal computer, the IBM PC
US doctors reported the first cases of what became known as AIDS

1982.t: Britain and Argentina fought a ten-week war over the Falkland Islands
The first compact discs and CD players went on sale
Italy won the World Cup in Spain

1983.t: Sally Ride became the first American woman in space
The ARPANET switched to TCP/IP, the protocol that still runs the internet
M*A*S*H's finale became the most-watched US TV episode ever

1984.t: A gas leak in Bhopal, India became history's worst industrial disaster
Carl Lewis won four golds at the Los Angeles Olympics

1985.t: Live Aid concerts in London and Philadelphia played to a global audience
Robert Ballard's team found the wreck of the Titanic
British scientists reported the ozone hole over Antarctica

1986.t: The Chernobyl nuclear reactor exploded, spreading fallout across Europe
The Soviet Union launched the Mir space station
Diego Maradona's Argentina won the World Cup in Mexico

1987.t: The Simpsons debuted as shorts on The Tracey Ullman Show
Stock markets crashed worldwide on Black Monday

1988.t: The first transatlantic fiber-optic cable entered service
A bomb destroyed Pan Am Flight 103 over Lockerbie, Scotland

1989.t: The Berlin Wall was opened and East Germans streamed west
Tim Berners-Lee proposed the World Wide Web at CERN
Chinese troops crushed the Tiananmen Square protests

1990.t: The Hubble Space Telescope reached orbit
Nelson Mandela walked free after 27 years in prison
Germany reunified after 45 years of division

1991.t: Russia, Ukraine and Belarus signed the accords dissolving the Soviet Union
The World Wide Web went public with the first website at CERN
A US-led coalition drove Iraqi forces out of Kuwait

1992.t: European leaders signed the Maastricht Treaty
Barcelona hosted the Olympics and the US basketball Dream Team
The Rio Earth Summit produced the first global climate treaty

1993.t: The European Union came into being as the Maastricht Treaty took effect
Israel and the PLO signed the Oslo Accord in Washington
Jurassic Park brought computer-generated dinosaurs to the screen

1994.t: South Africans of all races voted and Nelson Mandela became president
The Channel Tunnel linked Britain and France
Some 800,000 people were killed in the Rwandan genocide

1995.t: Astronomers found 51 Pegasi b, the first planet around a Sun-like star
A truck bomb destroyed the Oklahoma City federal building, killing 168

1996.t: Dolly the sheep, the first mammal cloned from an adult cell, was born
Atlanta hosted the centennial Summer Olympics
The Taliban took Kabul and imposed their rule on Afghanistan

1997.t: Britain returned Hong Kong to China
IBM's Deep Blue beat world chess champion Garry Kasparov in a match
The first Harry Potter book was published

1998.t: Larry Page and Sergey Brin founded Google
The first modules of the International Space Station were joined in orbit
Northern Ireland's peace deal, the Good Friday Agreement, was signed

1999.t: Eleven EU countries adopted the euro for electronic payments
NATO bombed Yugoslavia during the Kosovo War

2000.t: Scientists announced the first draft of the human genome
Sydney hosted the Summer Olympics and Cathy Freeman won the 400m
The first resident crew moved into the International Space Station

2001.t: The September 11 attacks destroyed the World Trade Center's twin towers

2002.t: Euro notes and coins entered circulation in twelve countries
Japan and South Korea co-hosted the World Cup, won by Brazil
The International Criminal Court was established in The Hague

2003.t: The Human Genome Project was completed
Concorde made its last commercial flight
A US-led coalition invaded Iraq and toppled Saddam Hussein

2004.t: SpaceShipOne became the first private craft to reach space
The Olympics returned to Athens, their ancient home
An Indian Ocean tsunami killed some 230,000 people in fourteen countries

2005.t: The Kyoto Protocol on greenhouse gases came into force

2006.t: Astronomers reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet
Italy won the World Cup in Germany

2007.t: The UN climate panel reported that warming is unequivocal and human-driven
US subprime mortgage losses set off a global financial crisis

2008.t: Barack Obama was elected the first Black US president
Usain Bolt broke the 100m and 200m world records at the Beijing Olympics
Lehman Brothers collapsed in the largest bankruptcy in US history

2009.t: US Airways Flight 1549 ditched in the Hudson River and all 155 aboard survived
The H1N1 swine flu pandemic spread worldwide

2010.t: The Burj Khalifa opened in Dubai as the world's tallest building

2011.t: A tsunami struck northeast Japan and crippled the Fukushima nuclear plant
The Space Shuttle flew its final mission

2012.t: The Curiosity rover landed in Gale Crater on Mars
CERN announced the discovery of the Higgs boson
Gangnam Style became the first video with a billion YouTube views

2013.t: Cardinal Bergoglio of Argentina became Pope Francis
Edward Snowden revealed mass surveillance by the NSA
A meteor exploded over Chelyabinsk, injuring more than a thousand people

2014.t: Rosetta's Philae probe made the first landing on a comet
Germany won the World Cup in Brazil
The largest Ebola epidemic on record swept West Africa

2015.t: Nearly 200 nations adopted the Paris climate agreement
New Horizons made the first flyby of Pluto
Coordinated attacks in Paris killed 130 people

2016.t: Britain voted to leave the European Union
Rio de Janeiro hosted South America's first Olympics
Donald Trump was elected US president

2017.t: Astronomers spotted the first known interstellar object, Oumuamua
A total solar eclipse crossed the United States from coast to coast
Millions joined Women's Marches the day after Trump's inauguration

2018.t: Twelve boys and their football coach were rescued from a flooded Thai cave
NASA launched the Parker Solar Probe to skim the Sun's corona
France won the World Cup in Russia

2019.t: Astronomers unveiled the first image of a black hole
Millions of students joined a global climate strike
Fire destroyed the roof and spire of Notre-Dame cathedral in Paris

2020.t: The COVID-19 pandemic shut down much of the world
SpaceX flew astronauts to the ISS, the first commercial crewed flight
The killing of George Floyd sparked protests worldwide

2021.t: Mass COVID-19 vaccination campaigns rolled out worldwide
NASA's Ingenuity made the first powered flight on another planet
The postponed Tokyo Olympics were held largely without spectators

2022.t: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine
The James Webb Space Telescope delivered its first images

2023.t: India's Chandrayaan-3 made the first landing near the Moon's south pole
OpenAI's GPT-4 led a wave of generative AI adoption
Hamas attacked Israel and the Gaza war began

2024.t: A total solar eclipse swept across North America
Donald Trump won a second, non-consecutive term as US president

2025.t: Robert Prevost became Pope Leo XIV, the first American pope
Sweeping new US tariffs disrupted global trade
Firefly's Blue Ghost made the first fully successful commercial Moon landing

2026.t: Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo hosted the Winter Olympics
The United States, Canada and Mexico co-hosted the FIFA World Cup
